name: Amaranth 0.1.0 (122)
body:
Build 122 (2dad4c3, release channel).

- T70: fix the Release fault-injection check in build-app.sh (strings | grep -q died of SIGPIPE under pipefail).
- T70: build number = commit count (stamped into app + worker), shared build-app.sh, publish.sh to GitHub Releases or a local folder.
- Stop recording automatically when the call app lets go of the microphone (default), or ask; 10 s instead of 30 s.
- Recording view: just the meeting title (no Live text / Provisional eyebrow or final-transcript note).
- Transcript: right-clicking a line's text opens the row menu, not the system text menu.
- T96: delete transcript lines; Start from Here… / End Here… trim the transcript and audio.
- Milestone Q un-parked and extended to GitHub Releases updates (user decision 2026-11-02).
- check.sh: fail when any swift test binary fails.
- Spec 0008: cited user lines stay out of the document (user decision 2026-10-31); note L parked.
- Reorder remaining milestones: loose ends → T21 → feedback round → F; park L, P, Q.
- Notes tab: "History" and "Footnotes" labels; Footnotes without the icon, set close together.
- Notes tab: pinned header and buttons, one editable region, Limitations as a footnote.
- Notes tab: empty state, Generate before Regenerate, sparkles icon.
- T95: Milestone R validation. Sonnet verdict v1 PASS WITH FIXES, fixes applied, verdict v2 PASS.
- T94: remove the old notes stores; docs; Milestone L revised on the notes document.
- T93: exports, search and Ask on the single notes field (spec 0008 §7).
- T92: notes while recording (spec 0008 §2).
- T91: one editable notes field in the Notes tab (spec 0008 §5, §6).
- T90: generation reads the notes document; user lines survive; snapshot publishing (spec 0008 §3–5).
- T89: notes document, storage and the library v6 migration (spec 0008 §1, §8).
